title: Accent or intonation? The vocative in Vedic
note: Title as given by David 2026-10-24; year, venue and pages not verified. Treats the initial high tone of Vedic vocatives and their low tone in non-initial position as intonation; the word-level accent of the vocative is the same as the nominative's. Web search 2026-10-24 found no record with this title; Keydana and Aufderheide's Early Vedic phonology slides (https://spw.uni-goettingen.de/projects/aig/doc/VED-PHO-003.pdf) state the positional pattern (vocatives accented on the first syllable when sentence-initial, otherwise unaccented); not the cited work.
